MasulloGRH.traceLocalNormalizedCutoff_zero.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 1 < T) (hψ : ψ 1 = 0) (hsupp : ∀ (t : ℝ), ψ t ≠ 0 → T⁻¹ < t ∧ t < T) (v : FinitePlace K)
  (hv : T < ↑(Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal)) [MeasurableSpace (LocalField K v)ˣ]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (LocalField K v)ˣ) (ρ : (LocalField K v)ˣ → ℂ) :
  ↑(Real.log ↑(Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal) / (μ {x | Valued.v ↑x = 1}).toReal) *
      ∫ (x : (LocalField K v)ˣ), ρ x * traceLocalIntegrand K χ ψ v x ∂μ =
    0
